proposal.summary: An app may be able to read sensitive location information due to insufficient redaction of log entries. This was fixed in macOS Ventura 13.5.
proposal.cwe_quote: An app may be able to read sensitive location information.

C.quote: An app may be able to read sensitive location information.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm exact affected macOS versions and determine the required app privileges/entitlements to read the logs; reproduce the issue to capture how location data appears in logs and whether third‑party apps can access those logs without user consent.

evidence_quotes.quote: A privacy issue was addressed with improved private data redaction for log entries.
This issue is fixed in macOS Ventura 13.5.
